title: Maximum Length of Subarray With Positive Product
summary: Given an array of integers, determine the longest continuous segment where the product of the elements is positive.
statement: Given an array of integers, determine the longest continuous segment where the product of the elements is positive. Return the length of this segment.
constraints: Return the greatest length of a contiguous subarray whose product is positive.
Zero breaks a candidate subarray; values may be negative.
reference_solution:
def longest_positive_product_subarray(nums):
 positive=negative=answer=0
 for value in nums:
  if value==0:positive=negative=0
  elif value>0:positive+=1;negative=negative+1 if negative else 0
  else:positive,negative=(negative+1 if negative else 0),positive+1
  answer=max(answer,positive)
 return answer

hints: Track longest positive-product and negative-product suffix lengths.
A positive value extends both; a negative value swaps their roles while extending; zero resets both.
Update the answer from the positive suffix.
Sign and length are the only suffix properties relevant to extending at the next element.
